_help.aliases: feed team name -> canonical name, if HockeyTech renames a team mid-season
_help.exclude_game_ids: HockeyTech game ids to drop (e.g. ACHA did not count it)
_help.score_fixes: {game_id: {hg, ag}} corrected home/away goals (also forces a game to count if not marked Final)
_help.tie_game_ids: league-playoff games that went to OT: counted as ties (Manual Part Five Art. IV Sec. 3C)
_help.add_games: [{id, date, home, away, hg, ag, ot, so}] games missing from the feed
_help.penalties: {team: deduction} confirmed ranking penalties; replaces the auto-suggested forfeit penalty for that team
_help.not_good_standing: [team] listed separately, not ranked (still counted in opponents' schedules)
_help.notes: free-text log of why each override exists
